set.body:
Objective
Adopt a short identity/composition/leakage/result constitution and an exact-revision migration ledger. Give every supported method and caller a destination, parity fixture, responsible role, and M1/M2/M3 deletion gate.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements FND-01, FND-05, PRED-01, REL-01, GLB-01. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
architecture; docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md; build.sbt; modules/mvpa*, response, locus-data, fit; workflow examples. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
None; ready after ordinary claim/preflight checks.. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Inventory Swift and correlation centroid, cross-decoding, probability conventions, operator ridge, feature models, samplewise RSA, MANOVA, signed/constrained canonical variants, dataset opening and exports.
2. Distinguish current adopted sources from historical candidate commits; preserve unrelated dirty work and immutable historical references.
3. No new legacy enum cases or public wrappers; temporary private bridges have no new callers and expire by the following migration gate, never after M3.
4. Keep generic fit independent of MVPA; assign general numerical work to Gale and semantic algebra to Multivar without prematurely splitting modules.

Verification
Review the explicit protocol/ledger against PRD and current source; validate links and source references. No numerical passing claim follows from writing a protocol. Record exact future scenario/benchmark commands and budgets at handoff.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
set.title: UMVPA-M0.01: Freeze the ownership constitution and complete the consumer/deletion inventory
